title: PCA via SVD

wrong.no_centering.py: SVD of the raw X (components follow the origin, not the data cloud)
wrong.variance_over_n.py: variances are s^2 / n instead of s^2 / (n - 1)
wrong.returns_u.py: returns the left singular vectors (n x k) instead of the rows of Vt
wrong.ratio_of_kept.py: ratio divides by the kept variance, so the top-k always sum to 1
wrong.no_sign_rule.py: skips the sign convention, so components may point either way
wrong.inverse_forgets_mean.py: pca_inverse does not add the mean back

hints: Centre first: Xc = X - mean. PCA describes the spread around the mean, not around the origin.
np.linalg.svd(Xc, full_matrices=False) gives Xc = U @ diag(s) @ Vt. The principal directions are the rows of Vt, and the variance along each is s**2 / (n - 1).
Sign rule: for each row of Vt, find the entry with the largest magnitude and flip the row if that entry is negative. Reconstruction is Z @ components + mean.
